name: change_unit_ability
description: Grant or remove a unit ability on any unit (any player's) via Unit:GetAbility():ChangeAbilityCount(abilityType, delta) in GameCore_Tuner (call shape from Firaxis' PiratesScenario/CivRoyale scripts). Use to buff a unit with e.g. ABILITY_GREAT_GENERAL_STRENGTH (+5 combat), ABILITY_IGNORE_ZOC, ABILITY_IGNORE_TERRAIN_COST, ABILITY_BYPASS_WALLS, ABILITY_MEDIC_HEAL, ABILITY_STEALTH (any GameInfo.UnitAbilities row), or to strip one (negative delta). Verified live turn 60: +1 ABILITY_GREAT_GENERAL_STRENGTH on an Archer raised its strength in the game's own combat simulation 30 -> 35, -1 restored 30; GetAbilityCount/HasAbility tracked it exactly. Params: unitId (required), ability (ABILITY_* type, required), delta (default 1; negative removes), playerId (unit owner, default Game.GetLocalPlayer()). Returns count/has before and after, CanHaveAbility, and the unit's full ability list. Note: Unit:GetCombat() does not reflect ability modifiers - check the effect with combat_preview. Needs a loaded game (GameCore_Tuner state exists only in-game).
lua:
local pid = P.playerId
if pid == nil then pid = Game.GetLocalPlayer() end
local row = GameInfo.UnitAbilities[P.ability]
if row == nil then emitJson({error = "unknown ability " .. tostring(P.ability)}) return end
local player = Players[pid]
if player == nil then emitJson({error = "no player " .. tostring(pid)}) return end
local u = player:GetUnits():FindID(P.unitId)
if u == nil then emitJson({error = "unit " .. tostring(P.unitId) .. " not found for player " .. tostring(pid)}) return end
local a = u:GetAbility()
local delta = P.delta
if delta == nil then delta = 1 end
local out = {unitId = P.unitId, playerId = pid, ability = P.ability, delta = delta}
out.canHave = a:CanHaveAbility(P.ability)
out.before = {count = a:GetAbilityCount(P.ability), has = a:HasAbility(P.ability)}
if delta ~= 0 then a:ChangeAbilityCount(P.ability, delta) end
out.after = {count = a:GetAbilityCount(P.ability), has = a:HasAbility(P.ability)}
local list = {}
for _, e in ipairs(a:GetAbilities() or {}) do
  local r = GameInfo.UnitAbilities[e.Ability]
  table.insert(list, {ability = (r and r.UnitAbilityType) or e.Ability, count = e.Count})
end
out.abilities = list
emitJson(out)
